# HUB Surface Systems

> Canadian leader in decorative stamped asphalt, preformed thermoplastic road markings, and specialty pavement coatings. Serving municipalities, contractors, and developers coast to coast since 1999.

HUB Surface Systems designs and installs purpose-built surface solutions engineered for Canadian climate conditions — freeze-thaw cycles, snowplow operations, and de-icing salt environments. Two regional offices serve all 10 provinces: East in Milton, Ontario and West in Ladysmith, British Columbia, backed by a national network of HUB-certified applicators.

## Products

- [StreetPrint](https://hubss.com/products/streetprint): In-place stamped asphalt. Cobblestone, brick, herringbone, and 12+ patterns impressed directly into existing asphalt. No demolition, no raised edges, snowplow-safe. 20+ year service life.
- [StreetBond](https://hubss.com/products/streetbond): UV-stable water-based acrylic coatings for bike lanes, bus lanes, driveways, and decorative surfaces. Full Pantone colour matching.
- [StreetBondSR](https://hubss.com/products/streetbondsr): Solar-reflective variant of StreetBond. High SRI rating reduces urban heat island effect. Contributes to the LEED V5 SS credit for urban heat island reduction.
- [TrafficPatterns](https://hubss.com/products/traffic-patterns): Preformed thermoplastic crosswalk markings, factory-manufactured to 125mil thickness. Specified by municipalities coast to coast.
- [TrafficPatternsXD](https://hubss.com/products/traffic-patterns-xd): Aggregate-reinforced preformed thermoplastic for BRT corridors, high-traffic intersections, and heavy vehicle environments. High skid resistance.
- [MMAX](https://hubss.com/products/mmax): MMA methyl methacrylate resin for red bus lanes, bike lanes, and coloured area markings. Traffic-ready in under an hour. Applies at +3°C and rising.
- [DecoMark](https://hubss.com/products/decomark): Custom preformed thermoplastic graphics for public art installations, community branding, school markings, and civic identity. Pantone-accurate, flush surface.
- [PreMark](https://hubss.com/products/premark): Preformed thermoplastic road symbols — arrows, stop bars, school zone legends, accessible parking symbols.
- [AirMark](https://hubss.com/products/airmark): Preformed thermoplastic airfield markings for taxiways, helipads, and apron surfaces.
- [DuraTherm](https://hubss.com/products/duratherm): Inlaid flush-mount thermoplastic crosswalk system.
- [DuraShield](https://hubss.com/products/durashield): Penetrating asphalt rejuvenator and protective seal coat. Extends pavement life.

## Applications

- [Crosswalks](https://hubss.com/applications/crosswalks): High-visibility decorative and regulatory crosswalks for Vision Zero and Complete Streets.
- [Bike Lanes](https://hubss.com/applications/bike-lanes): Coloured cycling infrastructure — StreetBond, MMAX, PreMark.
- [Bus Lanes](https://hubss.com/applications/bus-lanes): BRT corridor and bus priority treatments for transit agencies.
- [Parking Lots](https://hubss.com/applications/parking-lots): Stall markings, wayfinding, surface rejuvenation.
- [Parks & Paths](https://hubss.com/applications/parks-paths): Decorative surfaces for urban greenways, plazas, and multi-use trails.
- [Playgrounds](https://hubss.com/applications/playgrounds): Vibrant, slip-resistant playground surface graphics.
- [Community Branding](https://hubss.com/applications/community-branding): Neighbourhood identity and civic pride embedded in street surfaces.
- [Public Art](https://hubss.com/applications/public-art): Civic-scale pavement murals and Indigenous art installations.
- [Private Driveways](https://hubss.com/applications/private-driveways): Stamped asphalt driveways — stone look, asphalt performance.
- [Airports](https://hubss.com/applications/airports): Certified airfield thermoplastic markings.
- [Sport Courts](https://hubss.com/applications/sport-courts): Permanent court coatings for tennis, basketball, pickleball.
- [LEED & Urban Heat Island](https://hubss.com/applications/leed-urban-heat-island): Solar-reflective paving for green building credits.
